content:
paula: Quick check — SOC2 checkpoint tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need owners for:
- KMS/HSM integration sign-off
- Audit log retention (prod & staging)
- Evidence owner for dev->prod key rotation playbook
@jin @alex can you confirm ownership? cc @maria for audit logs.

jin: I'll own KMS/HSM sign-off. I'll run the attestation checklist today.

jin: action: update PR in infra/keystore repo and ping security for review.

alex: I can own audit log retention.

alex: current retention: prod 7 years, staging 90 days. confirm ok?

maria: 7 years for prod sounds right per legal. staging 90 days is fine but we need sampled artifacts for fieldwork.

tom: For dev->prod evidence, product infra should provide runbook + S3 evidence path. I can be owner if no objections.

paula: Thanks. jin can you paste checklist items you'll sign off on?

jin: here's the checklist I'll run:
```
- HSM attestation present
- KMS key policy reviewed
- Encryption in transit validated (TLS1.2+)
- Key rotation schedule >= 90 days
- Proof-of-possession logs exported to s3://redwood-compliance/kms-evidence/
```

jin: I'll open a ticket and add links.

security-bot: Ticket created: REDW-4821 "HSM/KMS attestation — SOC2" assigned to jin. Link: https://tracker.redwood.internal/REDW-4821

maria: I'll assemble sampled artifacts from prod logs — where should I put them? Tom?

tom: Put artifacts under s3://redwood-compliance/audit-samples/2026-03-17 and share a presigned link to the reviewer group.

paula: Great. Last Q: any blockers on running the rotation proof in staging before fieldwork window?

jin: Staging keys are on soft-HSM; rotation proof needs small script update. I'll do it by EOD.

alex: I'll update retention policy docs in the compliance repo and add a note for auditor access.

paula: Thanks all. I'll update the milestone board and mark owners. :thumbsup:
